title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Determine the Crime of Misappropriation of State-owned Funds by Persons Entrusted with the Management and Operation of State-owned Property

articles.content_en:
Judicial Interpretation No. 5 [2000]

Higher People's Court of Jiangsu Province:

Your Court's Request No. 94 [1999] of Su Gao Fa, "Request for Instructions on Whether Persons Entrusted with the Management and Operation of State-Owned Property Can Be Subject to the Crime of Misappropriation of Public Funds", has been received. Upon review, we reply as follows:

Where a person who is not a state functionary, having been entrusted by a state organ, state-owned company, enterprise, institution, or people's organization to manage and operate state-owned property, takes advantage of his or her position to misappropriate state-owned funds for personal use, thereby constituting a crime, the person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 272, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law.

This is our reply.
